title: The Navajo code was never broken, and it was two codes deep
body: US Marines in the Pacific used Navajo code talkers whose system combined an unwritten language with a substitution code for military terms, spoken at machine-gun speed without machines. Japanese intelligence never cracked it, and a captured code talker forced to translate literal Navajo produced nonsense, because the code layer hid inside the language layer. Obscurity worked once, as a weapon with native speakers as the key.
source_hint: US Marine Corps / National Archives, code talker histories
